response.sql: WITH team_totals AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(games) AS total_games FROM home_game GROUP BY team_id), overall AS (SELECT SUM(games) AS all_games, AVG(games) AS avg_games FROM home_game) SELECT t.team_id, t.total_games, CAST(t.total_games AS REAL) / o.all_games AS fraction_of_all_games, CAST(t.total_games AS REAL) / o.avg_games AS ratio_to_avg_record FROM team_totals AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY (ratio_to_avg_record IS NULL), ratio_to_avg_record DESC LIMIT 10
